evidence:
Scoped to workbook quality check 18: the frozen reference plausibly satisfies the graded dimensions. This is not a claim of Oracle 1, a complete configured judge run, a target-model result, or hosted acceptance. I walked all 86 functional, 14 polish, 6 visual criteria and both gate criteria; no criterion was found that this golden inherently cannot satisfy.

The seed checks have matching 7 requisitions, 13 offers, 3 referring employees, 8 commitment tuples, 1 grant, 2 signing payments and 2 referrals; supplied and co-located solution seeds are byte-identical. The implementation seeds once (task/solution/app/src/db.js:122), exposes raw/derived product records and stored snapshots (src/index.js:120-230), and resolves authenticated identity and role restrictions from the session (src/index.js:71-93). Validation and exact arithmetic support the input, composition, band, date and overflow criteria (src/index.js:233-254; src/rules.js:24-99); approval/revision/rescission execute inside transactions with current-status, dual-control, authority and live-budget guards (src/index.js:286-416). Revision preserves predecessor economics, posts separate reversal/replacement and signing adjustment, supersedes the former grant and mints the revised grant from the original start; rescission settles only the current hire. Calendar anniversaries, separate vesting schedules, referral fixed clock and net ledger calculations are implemented in src/rules.js:32-186. Stored receipts and human-readable audit are appended at src/index.js:277-284, supporting all history/after-image criteria.

The browser implementation provides the visible complete compensation breakdown and all lifecycle actions with encoded arbitrary IDs (public/js/hireops.js:121-209), exact cents conversion/prefill (14-25), six workspaces and structured expandable before/after receipts (381 onward). Native navigation/main landmarks and labelled fields are present in public/index.html and the workspace forms. public/js/app.js:114-226 implements readable pending/error states, retained failed-form entries, focus management and retry; :232 onward supplies live dashboard metrics and :325 theme persistence. CSS defines consistent light/dark typography, cards, statuses, forms and deliberate responsive stacking at styles.css:241-259. The inspected mobile-audit-dark.png shows a legible coherent audit/receipt presentation with intentional table scrolling. Those sources support plausible visual credit; they do not establish six measured Likert scores.

I independently recomputed every indexed artifact/driver hash and every matching_source_files binding: 97 artifacts, 4 drivers and 385 bindings matched. Concrete observations include domain/results.json (SHA256 96b7f34132e705013a7ef605d139de3ebac0274b508ca5f43cb5372584b841bd) and the UTF-16 domain-run.log recording 77 passing local HTTP assertions with no failures. Actual domain/requests.json responses for domain-offer-47 show approval headroom 189999823 cents, revision headrooms 188999447 and 190999022, then rescission restoring 200000000 with signing retained 480002, clawback 720003, equity retained 3/cancelled 10; stale ancestor/latest rescinded requests return 409. Browser ui/results.json (SHA256 0b8cf0734fdd1f3bf5a503c997970550fd799bc88b869d03e95833d89b461ba7) records 16 passing checks, including unusual-ID actions, visible complete breakdown, retained revision fields, all six screens at 390px, exact large-money create/prefill/revision, and one aborted rescission request followed by unchanged retry success. I inspected the driver assertions, including preservation and correction rather than trusting result labels. The supplementary precision driver uses zero default units and base 1.00/1.01, so it is not the exact nonzero-unit/base-100/101 criterion witness; the golden source still handles the required one-unit equal-spread case through the same exact converters and mintGrant path.

MCP recorded separate empty-context Auditor sign-in/readback, and install-lifecycle/results.json (SHA256 613da9cf8e275402f708957981b3cefe2236d55803f7b9efaaee7618e1ff15a8) records sanitized unprivileged launch, actual shared restart process replacement 21 -> 97 retaining saved data and a single-use refusal. These are product/tool observations, not full judge execution. configured-inspection/results.json explicitly records parser/schema/argument launch only and NO provider grade. Accordingly run_verdict is PARTIAL and any global clearance still requires the separate configured timing/grading/reward measurements required by review policy; this plausible-coverage row does not waive them.

Adversarial check: a seed-only/no-op creation app could look complete, but the indexed gate witness fails its independent saved-record readback; a dead-approval app passes the intentionally minimal pending-record prerequisite but cannot earn the positive-control settlement criteria. The measured gross-equity mutation yields 2000 intrinsic/500 annualized cents instead of golden 1000/250 and fails those independent observations, while the golden implements the required spread arithmetic. Conforming-alternative check (reasoned, not a new run): nonmodal forms, stacked readable economics, dollar-valued response schemas, equivalent labels and independent detail screens are accepted explicitly; these do not force a golden-only design. No counterexample establishes an impossible criterion for this reference. Risk=false is scoped to this plausibility judgment, not overall runtime clearance.
